# Common definitions

`schemas/common/defs.json`

Shared scalar shapes (docs/design/m0/02). Formats prefixed adc- are asserted by internal/contract, which defines them.

## Definitions

### Outcome

The four outcomes. There is no boolean ok.

Type: one of `found`, `empty`, `could_not_run`, `failed`

### ReasonCode

A registered reason code (schemas/vocab/reasons.yaml). adc-reason asks internal/vocab, which readers and writers share; a document with an unregistered code is invalid.

Type: string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`, format `adc-reason`)

### Digest

Content digest: sha256 over the bytes, lowercase hex.

Type: string (pattern `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

### GitID

Git object id with the algorithm explicit by length: sha1 (40 hex) or sha256 (64 hex).

Type: string (pattern `^git:([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$`)

### Time

RFC 3339 in UTC with a Z suffix and a valid calendar date and clock time (adc-time).

Type: string (pattern `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,9})?Z$`, format `adc-time`)

### Duration

ISO 8601 duration of days and clock units, at least one component (PT30M, P1D, PT1H30M).

Type: string (pattern `^P([0-9]+D(T([0-9]+H([0-9]+M)?([0-9]+S)?|[0-9]+M([0-9]+S)?|[0-9]+S))?|T([0-9]+H([0-9]+M)?([0-9]+S)?|[0-9]+M([0-9]+S)?|[0-9]+S))$`)

### TypeID

Standard TypeID: prefix, underscore, 26-char lowercase base32 of a UUIDv7 (adc-typeid checks the version and variant). Fields use the entity-specific definitions below.

Type: string (pattern `^[a-z]{2,3}_[0-7][0-9a-hjkmnp-tv-z]{25}$`, format `adc-typeid`)

### NoteBody

A note's text (08 notes): untrusted data, stored and served as is and never interpreted (03-knowledge-layer supervisor continuity). 1 to 8192 characters, with no control character but tab and newline.

Type: string (pattern `^[^\x00-\x08\x0b-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]+$`, minLength `1`, maxLength `8192`)
